title: 'Who in the hell is that kid?' From football beginner to NFL draft in 4 years

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 'Who in the hell is that kid?' From football beginner to NFL draft in 4 years
sources.description: Max Iheanachor moved to the U.S. from Nigeria when he was 13. His high school didn't have football. And yet he's a likely NFL draft first-round pick. Here's how.
